_comment: Sponsor slots. Prices are reserve (minimum) bids in USD; people bid above them. A null sponsor renders nothing except the lifetime slot, which shows the auction card. Update high_bid as bids arrive and rebuild.

lifetime.label: Lifetime sponsor
lifetime.position: Top of the right rail beside the Top 3 podium on desktop, directly under the search bar on phones. Above the fold on every screen size.

header.label: Header strip
header.position: One slim text unit under the hero, above the search bar, on every homepage visit.

rail.label: Right rail
rail.position: A 300 pixel wide unit directly below the lifetime sponsor. It stays pinned while the visitor scrolls the package grid.

footer.label: Footer row
footer.position: One of three units in a sponsor row above the site footer, after the FAQ and newsletter.
